cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your school meeting went fine, love. The headteacher and I discussed your suspension. Have some tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How long am I suspended?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. A little while. I'll be home with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will I miss the school play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, sweetheart. Come sit beside me. You don't have to face this alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quicker. I've used three mugs already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Show me the mug, and I'll weigh one mugful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How long am I suspended?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A little while. I'll be home with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will I miss the school play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, sweetheart. Come sit beside me. You don't have to face this alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your wedding dress reached our depot this morning. Please sit; I'll look after you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Which depot? I'll collect it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One of ours. Let me save you a wasted journey.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you at least give me their number?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You have me, and I'm staying right here with you.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll name the coworker who reported your lateness if you name whoever reported mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only know which department.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then I'll trade departments. Names cost names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Payroll. But I can introduce you to my source.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Marketing. And I'll arrange coffee with mine. Same access, same price.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Then I'll trade departments. Names cost names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Payroll. But I can introduce you to my source.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll tell you why I took Mum's spare key if you admit something that could get you grounded too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I broke her mug.

beats.text: That's a weekend. This key is a month. Have you got anything bigger?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I lent her car to Jamie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A month each, then. I used the key to let Jamie move into her flat.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll be honest about your missing donation box. You asked where I went; I said the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you take the box there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Yes. You didn't ask what was inside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Was the money still in it when you arrived?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the car park, yes. If you mean the counter, that's a different arrival.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Our toaster receipt is gone. The shop must have someone inside this house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I probably recycled it. We can get a copy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. So the recycling crew removes originals while the shop prints replacements.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every shop prints replacement receipts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Every shop? Then it's the whole high street. We can't trust a single warranty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please. Ask which shelf it eats from. We can't keep making our guest explain everything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our invisible dinner guest is here. Will you introduce Mum while I finish the gravy?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't see where to look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The chair beside you. Just introduce them as you normally would.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Hello, chair, this is Mum. She needs your seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Introduce her to the guest, love. Then fetch another chair; we can't ask someone to stand just because Mum can't see them.
